_about: The trip finder's own numbers (TF1, T793 and T794): how many trips it builds and from what, the trip length and month when the setup gave none, and how the trips are ranked. Prices are not here: every figure comes from the price engine (config/pricing.json).

rank._blend: Trips for you only (owner, 2026-10-30, T884): the order and the match badge are one number, blend = answers x answers_w + quality / 10 x quality_w, where answers is the trip's fit F mixed with its persona fit P (persona_w of it, when a persona is chosen) and quality the places' month score. The budget sink and the flight lever move it by their points / 10. The badge shows round(blend x 100), capped at 99, while F reads at least match.show_min. Explore's For you keeps Q + lambda (F - 0.5).

persona._about: How the traveller likes to travel (owner, 2026-10-30): ten personas, up to three chosen in Help me choose (g:persona), one maybe marked most you (T891). Each place gets a persona fit P in 0..1 from its own features (lib/recommend/persona.js), weighted per persona below; with several picks a place's P is the best of them, each times its weight (1 for the one most you, or every pick when none is marked; otherW for the rest); the trip finder adds weight x (P - 0.5) to the country's place pool key and to each trip's score, so the persona moves a place by up to weight / 2 points. The trip finder only: the rating and Explore never read it. hubKm: a metro within the first figure counts fully as near, past the second not at all. around: good places (score at least aroundMin) within aroundKm, full at aroundCap. reasonMin: a trip names its persona from this fit, and reasonFacts are the facts each reason needs (a place count, a feature value) before it is said. shapes: the shapes a persona builds when What kind of trip has no answer. towns: a persona's own reach between a trip's places. The question shows each persona as a photograph of a place that fits it, its name and one line in the traveller's words (owner, plan flow studio 2026-10-30, T892).
